summary: Make plugin manifest and agent instructions CLI-agnostic (Epic #202 / Feature #205)

entries.migration_impact: Plugin metadata now points to akasper/plate and removes CLI-vendor-specific wording so standards-compatible CLI agents can install and use PLATE guidance consistently.
entries.agent_notes: Use /plugin install akasper/plate. Q&A guidance now refers to host-agent native interactive primitives and avoids vendor-specific wording.
